case: Lt Col Prithi Pal Singh Bedi v Union of India
narrow_holding_or_observation: Rule 180 does not require constituting a Court of Inquiry before every court-martial; once inquiry affects reputation, affected person must be afforded full participation

case: Ranjit Thakur v Union of India
pinpoint: Judgment PDF pp2 and 6–7; SCR pp513–514 and 519–521
narrow_holding_or_observation: Violation of Section 130 safeguards concerning challenge to court-martial members can vitiate proceedings; bias and proportionality questions are case-context dependent

case: Om Prakash v Union of India
